authorized_reporting_metrics.limitation: Subject to month-end adjustments and excludes partner-served ads; not the contractual eligible-net share base.
Reported creator net after applicable ownership/revenue-share adjustments, Google-sold only, not gross ads or actual bank funds.
Includes non-ad revenue, may contain estimatedAdRevenue and Premium components; do not add those again.
Estimated Premium allocation, not gross subscription receipts; may be included within estimatedRevenue.
A single monetized video playback can have multiple ad impressions.
Can include a viewer who saw a preroll ad but exited before the actual video began; API reports expected +/-2% error.
Advertiser gross, not creator RPM or watch-page eligible net.
Monetized-playback denominator differs from ad impression denominator and raw public views.

midroll_eligibility.limitations: A time slot on an eligible monetized 8-minute-or-longer video is only an opportunity; the system determines if an ad serves.

interpretation_gates: Never multiply advertiser grossRevenue by 55% to infer creator payout: eligible net revenues are a different undisclosed denominator.
Never infer estimatedAdRevenue from grossRevenue, monetizedPlaybacks, cpm, playbackBasedCpm or raw public views without authorized, compatible accounting inputs.
Do not add estimatedRevenue to estimatedAdRevenue or estimatedRedPartnerRevenue; those are potential subcomponents of the total.
Ad impressions count ads; monetized playbacks count video-playback events with at least one ad; raw public views are a third denominator.
An ad slot on an eight-minute eligible long-form video is an opportunity, not a guaranteed impression, payment or minimum creator wage.
Even known creator estimated net ad revenue is not bank-settled net take-home or after-expense profit.
